{{Top|leg}}
'''Kwenn Space Station Precinct''' was the local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] on [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Ketton/Legends|Ketton]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Derrida/Legends|Derrida]] falsified Kwenn Space Station Precinct reports to falsely indicate that [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Zhir-Khan]] committed [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
